GenerateArtifactWorkflow.cs.Label: Workflow Class
GenerateArtifactWorkflow.cs.Description: This workflow was designed to contain the full set of steps needed to generate an artifact. Artifact generation is inside a try-catch block to handle any exceptions that occur and log errors when necessary. The time spent on each step is recorded to help identify bottle necks. And optional logging is performed to aid in development. This setup also provides an easy way to reorder steps in the artifact generation pipeline.

Notes.Label: Canceled Operations
Notes.Text: When a request is canceled in the middle of artifact generation, error logging is skipped and the execution is re-thrown right away. This avoids unnecessary logging when no actual error occurred and doesn't waste time or memory returning a default/failure response that won't be used anyway.

Notes.Label: Optional Logging
Notes.Text: Logging for unidentified tokens and token semantic data can be toggled ON/OFF using config values set in the appsettings.json file.
